coreMemory.english: v. to keep or bring something back to mind
coreMemory.structure: remember to do /rɪˈmembər tu du/（记得去做）；remember doing /rɪˈmembər duɪŋ/（记得做过）；remember someone clearly /rɪˈmembər sʌmwʌn klɪrli/（清楚地记得某人）；remember the difference /rɪˈmembər ðə dɪfɚəns/（记住差别）
coreMemory.commonError: ❌ can to remember → ✅ can remember；❌ to remembering → ✅ to remember

commonErrors.note: 情态动词 can 后直接接动词原形，不加 to。
不定式 to 后接动词原形；不要把不定式和 -ing 形式混合。

coreMemory.example: Remember to save your work before you leave.

synonyms.difference: remember 是本卡核心搭配 “remember to do something” 中的中性常用选择；recall 含义接近，但语体、宾语范围和固定搭配可能不同，不能机械互换。

antonyms.usage: 在本卡核心义下与 remember 构成最直接的语义对比；实际使用前仍要核对词性和句型。

examples.english: Remember to save your work before you leave.

examples.english: The phrase “remember to do something” is useful in everyday English.
examples.chinese: “remember to do something”是日常英语中的实用表达。

examples.chinese: 我把 remember 和它的发音记进了笔记本。

examples.english: I reviewed “remember” again before going to bed.
examples.chinese: 睡前我又复习了一遍 remember。
